title: A fleet lane must never run without a written lane-scope.json: without it Committed() falls to the agent's top_n
problem: committedset.Committed prefers a non-empty lane pin and otherwise falls through to triage-decision.json's top_n, which the triage agent authors (and which the host may now derive from the agent's report, ADR-0106 H1). The pin is written best-effort. A fleet lane provisioned without one hands the agent full control of what the host claims from the inbox. Found by the ADR-0106 security review (2026-09-26).
fix: Make the pin a precondition of a fleet lane's dispatch: the loop refuses to launch a lane whose lane-scope.json is absent or empty, and the cycle refuses to run triage in fleet mode without it, with a coded signal naming the lane.
acceptance: A fleet lane with no pin does not reach triage; the refusal is a coded signal.
A sequential cycle (no fleet) is unaffected.
The provisioning path that writes the pin is covered by a test that fails when the write is skipped.
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: A latent integrity hole (the agent picks what the host claims) behind a best-effort write; no instance observed.
